items.title: 8.4 Policies, Regulations, and Responsible Innovation (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu of topic 8.4: the text before its first sub-heading (PDF 117-118, printed 113-114).

blocks.text: Jaise jaise emerging technologies aage barh rahi hain, in ke mehfooz aur akhlaqi istemal ke liye wazeh policies aur zimmedarana ijaad ke tareeqe zaroori hain (Figure 8.7). Qawaneen, governance frameworks (hukmrani ke dhaanche) aur mukhtalif shobon ka ishtirak tarakki aur jawabdehi mein tawazun rakhte hain. Yeh samajh kar ke policies technology ki tarakki ko kaise shakal deti hain, talaba aise hal banana seekh sakte hain jo insaf aur shamooliyat qaim rakhein aur muashre ki bhalai mein hissa dalein.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: AI, IoT, Cloud aur Blockchain ko mila kar rozmarra zindagi ke liye zyada smart aur kaar-amad systems banaye ja sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Patle frame mein bina label ki tasveer (sirf chip par AI likha hai): baayein adalat ka hathora (gavel) apne block par, beech mein tick wali dhaal (shield), aur daayein circuit pins wali AI chip.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.7: Policies aur akhlaqi usool zimmedarana ijaad aur technology mein users ke huqooq ki hifazat yaqeeni banate hain (kitab ki Figure 8.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Figure mein aur koi text nahi; caption policies, akhlaqi usool (ethical guidelines), zimmedarana ijaad aur users ke huqooq ka naam leta hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure 8.7 mein teen nishan hain: baayein adalat ka hathora (gavel), yani qanoon aur policies; beech mein tick wali dhaal (shield), yani hifazat (protection) aur users ke huqooq (rights) ki hifazat; aur daayein AI chip, yani technology. Matlab: qanoon aur akhlaqi usool (ethical guidelines) technology ko is tarah chalate hain ke ijaad zimmedarana ho aur users mehfooz rahen.

blocks.prompt: Kitab ke mutabiq kaun si teen cheezein tarakki (progress) aur jawabdehi (accountability) mein tawazun rakhti hain?
blocks.explanation: Qawaneen (laws), governance frameworks aur mukhtalif shobon (disciplines) ka mil kar kaam karna (collaboration).

items: Wazeh policies aur responsible innovation technology ke mehfooz aur akhlaqi istemal ke liye zaroori.
Laws, governance frameworks aur collaboration tarakki aur jawabdehi mein tawazun laate hain.
